cases.name: You Happen On a Glade
cases.text:
Choose one —
• Journey On — Search your library for up to two basic land cards, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle.
• Make Camp — Return target permanent card from your graveyard to your hand.

cases.name: You Happen On a Glade
cases.text:
Choose one —
• Journey On — Search your library for up to three basic land cards, reveal them, put them into your hand, then shuffle.
• Make Camp — Return target permanent card from your graveyard to your hand.
